prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences, ground tiles, icons and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres,
slightly soft hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows
where one sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph /
stencil print grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Weathering is welcome: irregular faded patches, not neat squares.
Details are built from few, large cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
stones, planks), not painted lines and not crowded tiny patterns. Plants are natural and
asymmetric.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Buildings: strictly frontal elevation, no perspective, three or four flat paper layers.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha including enclosed
holes, no backdrop, no glow, no chroma-key colour, no coloured fringe), every object complete
and separated by clear transparent gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the
object, no text, no captions, no logos.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Create a single Royal Poinciana (Delonix regia) game sprite by editing input 1, flameTree-ikebana-base. Preserve exactly three layered canopy masses of different sizes in its asymmetric scalene arrangement, the clear transparent gaps between them, and the large pinnate cut-paper leaf sprigs at their edges. Use a broad umbrella outline, low lateral branching, an angular folded-paper trunk, and the stylized leaf drawing of the transparent edit target.
Make the crown 1.4–1.6 times the height of the entire tree, from crown top to root tips. Keep three distinct masses with unequal spacing. Spread the low main branches outward nearly horizontally. Construct the trunk as a few flat tapered kraft-paper segments with distinct angular bends, oblique forks and irregular changes in width. Keep planar facets and avoid twisting, spirals, braiding, and rounded tubes.
Replace oversized hibiscus-like flowers with small asymmetrical five-petaled poinciana blooms, about half the size of the base flowers, 36–54 pixels across on a sprite whose visible height is about 780 pixels. Four muted orange-red petals with slender claws and softly ruffled tips, one ivory or pale yellow banner petal with fine coral-red streaks, delicate separate curved stamens. Use exactly three or five unevenly sized blossoms per cluster and three to five clusters total along the upper edges of the three crowns. Keep ample exposed sage foliage. Real flower and canopy morphology reference: Taiwan Landscape Plants Delonix regia and Taoyuan protected-tree species guide.
One complete wide landscape sprite, target visible silhouette approximately 1170 x 780 pixels and narrow transparent margins on all sides. Muted coral, sage and warm brown, obvious paper fibre and printed grain, slight shadows confined to overlapping paper. True native alpha in all exterior areas and between branches, zero halo, no ground, no text.
The surrounding pixels and the gaps must be fully empty alpha 0, with no vignette or lighting layer. Exactly three very small flowers per cluster, one cluster atop each mass. At landscape canvas scale keep individual flower heads about 3–4% of the complete tree width, visibly smaller than the large compound leaf sprigs. Build the trunk as one solid zigzag silhouette made of end-to-end sections, with no diagonal bands wrapping around it.
notes: 內建 image_gen。flameTree.png 選用 candidate-2.png，保留生成尺寸與原生 alpha。以 alpha ≥ 128 量得輪廓約 1517 × 973 px，冠幅／全樹高約 1.56。三團樹冠各有三朵，部分主花超過 54 px，樹幹仍可見斜向疊紙，樹高大於約 780 px 的目標。淺底合成確認大面積枝間留白透明，原圖最外緣仍有微量低 alpha 像素。第一版使用三張附件，第二版使用透明底稿，第三版編修第二版，第四版依同一構圖重新生成。實景參考：台灣景觀植物介紹（花部實照）https://tlpg.hsiliu.org.tw/plant/view/49；桃園市樹木保護資訊網（樹冠、水平枝）https://memorial-tree.tycg.gov.tw/species/10；農業知識入口網（花葉形態）https://kmweb.moa.gov.tw/theme_data.php?id=403&theme=plant_illustration。

Use case: stylized-concept
One isolated Delonix regia tree game sprite cut from printed paper. Native transparent PNG alpha, all space outside paper and between branches zero alpha, no ambient lighting or glow. On a landscape canvas, draw the tree itself approximately 1170 px wide and 780 px tall. Design a naturally asymmetric low, broad umbrella with three discrete scalloped sage paper canopy masses, a large high crown just right of center, a medium lower left crown, and a small lower-right crown. Wide open triangular gaps between crowns and branches. Large pale sage pinnate leaf cutouts drape from crown edges, a few per mass, each with prominent paired oval leaflets. Beneath the three crowns a short light brown angular tree trunk of flat tapered paper runs through two crisp zigzag bends, with longitudinal paper facets and wide, low lateral branches with sharp oblique forks. Make bark pieces visibly meet end-to-end, no crossed decorative diagonal paper bands.
Place one compact cluster of three small unequal Delonix flowers at the upper edge of each crown, each bloom just 36–54 pixels wide, with four pale muted scarlet-orange, narrow-clawed and softly ruffled petals plus a distinctive cream flag petal with red streaks, and fine red-orange stamens. The whole span of one flower cluster is about one ninth of the tree's width, and one flower is about one third as wide as a pinnate sprig. Flat visible paper fibers and grain. Complete margins, transparent interstices, no ground or extra objects.
